_comment: Collectible figures (DESIGN.md §6.6), read by FigureTable (checked when the items load: FigureTable.problems()) and Figures. The figures themselves are the items in data/items/figures/ (category figure, 1x1, stats set and model). shelf: the hideout station that displays them (its levels' display_slots in data/hideout/stations.json) and how many slots one shelf board holds (columns). sets: in the order the COLLECTION screen lists them; a set's bonus (type, value) is on while every figure of the set is on the shelf: search_speed (share faster loot search), pmc_kill_xp (share more XP for a PMC kill), trader_prices (share off trader buy prices and on trader sell rates, never past the resale floor), boss_chance (added to every boss's chance, up to 100%), metabolism (share slower energy and hydration drain), drip_spin (free Drip slot spins a real day), exploration_xp (share more XP for exploring a point of interest). sources: where figures drop, each a chance and a loot table of data/loot_tables/figures/ (rolled on a stream of their own, so nothing else changes): container (any searched container; chances: other chances by LootContainer id), scav_body and pmc_body (AI bodies; a PMC's is of its own faction's table faction_share of the time), boss (the boss's own figure, bosses.json "figure"), landmark (an original point of interest's own figure, pois.json "figure", in one of its containers), flea (per_refresh: the chance one figure listing goes up at a refresh). Never in a Shooting Range practice raid.
